Job Description
Strike Warfare Intelligence Analysts perform Tasking, Collection, Processing, Exploitation, and Dissemination (TCPED) of all-source tactical
intelligence; perform tactical and operational level research and analysis; assist in the management of Joint/Afloat targeting process; assist in parsing
the Air Tasking Order (ATO), Air Combat Operations (ACO), and Carrier Air Wing (CVW); assist in management of flight schedules and Special
Instructions (SPINS); conduct analysis of force disposition, capabilities, tactics, and training in support of strike mission planning; provide support of
Suppression of Enemy Air Defense (SEAD); identify adversary critical nodes and centers of gravity to maximize force employment; conduct target
development, dynamic and deliberate targeting, and precise geopositioning and mensuration; conduct Battle Damage Assessment (BDA), Bomb Hit
Assessment (BHA), and Collateral Damage Estimates (CDE); produce precise navigational aids and products for Precision Guided Munitions (PGM);
use various tactical databases/systems, tools, and applications to produce textual and graphical representations of the operational area, Target Folders,
Kneeboard Products, and tactical intelligence reports and briefings; maintain and update local/unit target deck/list; perform imagery ingest and
screening; maintain local image library of National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) approved imagery for geopositioning and mensuration use;
and assist in Combat Search and Rescue (CSAR) and Close Air Support (CAS) operations.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
